newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Fedsure buys two UK firms.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Fedsure buys two UK firms.

text.p: South African financial services firm Fedsure Ltd said on Thursday it was buying two British-based endowment policy traders for a total of 200 million rand.
The firms are Beale Dobie and Policy Portfolio Plc.

"These acquisitions further develop Fedsur's expansion into the UK market and form part of our international strategy to complement our extensive South African activities," Fedsure chief executive Arnold Basserabie said in a statement.
"Fedsure will be a leading player in traded endowment policies in the UK and will be well-positioned to take advantage of growth that will be generated over the next several years," he added.
The two British firms have a turnover of more than 500 million rand in a market estimated to have a value of six billion rand.
The move is the latest in a flurry of overseas deals so far this month from Fedsure.

On June 18 the firm bought a 25 percent stake in Irish Life International (ILI) for an undisclosed sum in a deal which itself followed hot on the heels of its first move abroad on June 10 when it bought a 25.5 percent stake in Isle of Man-based Kingfisher Group.
